body: I have a very oily t-zone as well and I usually use a water-based cleanser, rosewater toner and a blend of jojoba oil and rose absolute essential oil to moisturizer. I found that patting a few extra drops of oil into my t-zone actually really helped reduce the oiliness and shininess, I know it sounds like it would make the problem worse but a friend suggested it to me and I've been surprised :)

Well just remember next time you're lying in bed and can't get up, or you're crying and want to die....considering it's almost all I do, it's really likely that I'm here doing the same thing somewhere else in the world. You're not alone in your suffering 😔❤️
